summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (settlement regression, worker+contractor return regression, dashboard pending_list filter, contractor WhatsApp endpoint, 404 handling). Frontend: OTP+profile flow works; AdCarousel renders ONLY images with no text/subtitle/MapPin/CTA overlays; 'Paused' badge shows on pointer press and disappears on release; PendingWageMarquee mounted inside stat-pending with exactly 2 items (WadvUI+CpayUI) after seeding a worker with advance and contractor with payment (plus 1 worker + 1 contractor without any advance/payment which correctly do NOT appear); contractor-whatsapp-btn visible in contractor detail 3-col export row.

issues: Console warning persists: Missing Description/aria-describedby for DialogContent (a11y warning, non-blocker; already reported in iteration_2)

critical_code_review_comments: PendingWageMarquee: worker.pending can be negative (e.g., -300 when only advance paid and no attendance) → marquee shows '−₹300'. Consider clarifying meaning of 'Pending' when advance > earned (currently overloaded to indicate money owed BY worker back to owner). Semantics OK but label 'Pending Wage' next to a negative value may confuse end users.
_compute_pending_list issues N+1 DB reads (one compute_worker_ledger per worker with advance). For farms with many workers this can be slow — consider batch aggregation.
server.py now ~1300 lines — split into modules recommended (auth, contractors, dashboard, reports).

seed_data_creation: test_iteration3.py creates TEST_ prefixed workers/contractors/attendance/advances/returns/payments/settlements. Frontend run creates WadvUI/WnoneUI workers and CpayUI/CnoneUI contractors + one advance + one payment.

Test files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (7 tests) and /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iteration 2 regressions). Frontend flow: OTP → /profile-setup (name + first district) → /dashboard shows stat-pending with pending-marquee when pending_list populated; contractor detail modal shows 3-col row PDF/Excel/WA with data-testid=contractor-whatsapp-btn.
